title: Arrival
scope: The 2016 film · Louise’s changing experience of time
premise: Louise’s visions look like memories. Understanding the visitors’ language reveals that they belong to a future she has not yet lived.
ending: Louise’s experience of time includes her future with Ian and their daughter Hannah. Information from a future encounter helps her act in the present; the family scenes are not simply an earlier chapter of her life.

people.name: Louise Banks
people.introduction: A linguist learning a language that changes how she experiences time.

events.title: Family scenes appear without their place in time
events.text: The film shows Louise with a daughter. At first, these scenes invite us to understand them as recollections. Their position in Louise’s life is the central reveal.
events.whenLabel: As the film first presents them

events.title: Louise begins learning the visitors’ language
events.text: Louise works with Ian to communicate with the heptapods. As her understanding grows, she experiences scenes from her own future.

events.title: She recognises a future, not a lost past
events.text: Louise comes to understand the experiences differently. Hannah belongs to the life she will share with Ian, rather than to a life that ended before the visitors arrived.

events.title: A future conversation contains what she needs now
events.text: Louise experiences a later meeting with General Shang. He gives her information about the phone call that changed his decision during the crisis.
events.whenLabel: A later reception, experienced during the crisis

events.title: She uses that information to make the call
events.text: During the crisis, Louise calls Shang and repeats the words learned through the future encounter. This helps avert an attack on the visitors.

events.title: She accepts the life she has glimpsed
events.text: Louise chooses the relationship and family whose joys and losses she has experienced in advance. The guide leaves open the wider philosophical question of how choice works in this story.

chapters.title: See how future knowledge acts now

sources.title: Repository story record
sources.note: Editorial pilot adapted from the repository. Scene wording and interpretation await a separate review against the primary work.

connections.label: Words learned at the later meeting enable Louise’s earlier phone call.
